title: Idle-wait Stop does not re-sync a delegated child's delegation attempt after setting the latch
outcome: From the carry-confirmation review of w-f917452faa71 on 98ad64fd (Claude delegation-1e66bf2e, Low). In request_stop_session, the admission-shortcut branch calls sync_delegation_attempt_for_child_session after its Stop, but the Idle-wait Brake path (stop_idle_waiting_session) returns without it. The Brake sets orchestrator_auto_dispatch_blocked, which delegation_child_hold reads. A delegated child stopped from the new child-footer Stop (nested delegations allow up to depth 3) can therefore change its hold without its parent's delegation record being re-synced until a later refresh. Fix direction: call sync_delegation_attempt_for_child_session after a successful Brake, off the lock, with a test for a delegated child with its own wait.
acceptance: Idle-wait Stop does not re-sync a delegated child's delegation attempt after setting the latch is done
